text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then, I am ready.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Is there something troubling 
you?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking there sure are a lot of 
rivals

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~, that is true. They are all such 
strong and fast girls."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: To stay ahead of everyone. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... defeating the "Monster" would 
be an utterly hopeless endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is about time. Well then, I shall be on 
my way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu... I'm so wicked nervous...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright, Spe-chan~? Deep breaths, 
just take deep breaths~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks, Grass-chan...! *inhale*, 
*inhales deeply*...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan, let it out, let it out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, with so many heavy hitters 
gathered here, looks like there won't be 
any turn for me~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm just gonna take it nice and easy~ 
Don't mind me at all~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still... heheh, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To ignore a girl with eyes saying "I'm 
definitely going to win"... Impossible, 
simply impossible~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh. Should I have worn sunglasses or 
something?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Graaaass!! Let's make today the best race 
ever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With a massive clash between you and El, 
we'll get the whole crowd hyped up to the 
max—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, with El's victory, there 
is emotion! Praise! A thunderous 
ovatiooon!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well now, well now... Is that really so? 
Fufufu.

—At last, the curtain rises on the Nippon 
Derby!
